title: Timescape Cosmology (Wiltshire)
efc_relevance: Inhomogeneous cosmology: apparent acceleration arises from backreaction of voids on light propagation, not a true cosmological constant. Competitor to every DE-based framework including EFC. Recent Pantheon+ and DES-SN5YR reanalyses revive Timescape as a viable late-time alternative. Discriminator: Timescape predicts no CMB-lensing enhancement from DE; EFC predicts specific Σ > 1 signal.
ledger_action: Logged as backreaction-based competitor. Required comparison in CMB-lensing tests.
